title: The Lid in the Mud
lines: Pam has a big red pot.
The pot has a tin lid.
A pup got the lid! It ran.
The lid is in the mud.
Pam is sad. Pam sat on a log.
The pup digs up the lid!
Pam hugs the pup. It naps.

questions.ask: Where did the lid end up?
questions.listenFor: In the mud. It is said right in the story. If your child is stuck, point at that line and let them read it again rather than telling them.

questions.ask: Who got the lid back, and how?
questions.listenFor: The pup, by digging. Listen for the digging part - that is the bit that turns the story around. If they just say "the pup," ask "and what did it do?"

questions.ask: Do you think Pam should stay mad at the pup? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: There is no wrong answer. You are listening for a reason from the story - the pup dug the lid up again, or the pup took it in the first place.
